data.body: Implementation complete in worktree reuse-replay-167e: _pass_replay + _replay_anchor helpers in reuse.py replay the stored sidecar's advisory/coaching/indeterminate + counts on PASS reuse (fail-open: absent/unreadable/mismatched/contradictory sidecar degrades to empty lists; attestation stays the validity authority; stored surfacing cap + drop_reason respected via sidecar bucket order). Both reuse paths now stamp coverage.replayed_review {verified_at_sha, reviewed_at}. CLI: _render_reuse_notation (extracted helper) names the output as the last review's result REPLAYED against the unchanged plan, keeps the --force pointer, and renders the recency anchor when present. Tests: new tests/unit/test_plan_review_reuse_replay.py seen RED first (5 failed pre-fix); existing b3e5/7e77 suites (test_plan_review_reuse.py, test_plan_review_reuse_type.py, lifecycle test_plan_review_gate.py — 89 passed) unweakened. make lint + typecheck green; complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0.
